description:
🚀 CyberNova X is a multidisciplinary team of five innovators competing in NASA Space Apps Challenge Meknès 2026.

We combine expertise in AI, software development, cybersecurity, data engineering, mathematics, biology, and embedded systems.

Our proposed project, MED-AI, explores intelligent astronaut health monitoring through data analytics, anomaly detection, and scientific research.

Together, we aim to transform complex space challenges into meaningful technological solutions.
